title: A source whose pages differ only by a query string
why: 91 of 107 pages captured from a real source were query strings the replica cannot address, and it was `diff` at the end of the chain that said so — as pages the replica serves nothing at, never as a limit the capture named. A friendly URL cannot hold a `?`, so this is a property of the source that decides whether it can be replicated at all.

notes.means: the capture names the pages it recorded that no friendly URL can address, at the phase that can still stop the run
